text: Ko jaŋtoo koo e kaaruuji Jakariyaa'u e Maryama (yo ɓe his); immorde e kabaruuji wirniiɗi, ɗi Men Wahyina e maaɗa an Nulaaɗo. A tawanooka e ɓen jannguɓe moƴƴuɓe nde ɓe wennjondiraynoo fii anndugol on jojjuɗo e ne'ugol Maryama, haa ɓe gerdi non "urba=kuraaje"; ɓe weddii karambi maɓɓe, karambol Jakariyaa'u ngol fooli (yo o his).
